declaration.preface:
Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics is dedicated to ethical business operations and environmental sustainability. We are committed to lowering our carbon footprint, protecting natural resources, and advancing sustainable development because, as a business in the beauty and personal care sector, we understand the potential environmental impact of our activities.

Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics is committed to designing, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality cosmetic products while operating in a manner that protects the environment and promotes the sustainable use of natural resources. Our approach includes responsible sourcing of ingredients, water conservation, efficient use of raw materials, waste reduction, and clean energy utilization, while fostering sustainability across our entire value chain.

We set annual environmental goals, develop the necessary capabilities, and allocate appropriate resources to achieve this policy through innovation, operational efficiency, and ensuring our supply chain aligns with our sustainability commitments.
declaration.declaration:
At Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics, we are committed to adhering to all applicable environmental laws and regulations. We engage our employees, establish performance standards, and implement an Environmental Management System to ensure compliance and foster continuous improvement.

We're using 2022 as the baseline year to track our sustainability progress.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, stakeholders, contractors, partners, customers, contractual workers, and anyone acting on behalf of following sites:

focusAreas: Responsible raw material and chemical management

Environmental Compliance: At Arminak Solutions LLC dba KBL Cosmetics, we are committed to adhering to all applicable environmental laws and regulations. We engage our employees, establish performance standards, and implement an Environmental Management System to ensure compliance and foster continuous improvement.
Ethical Ingredient Sourcing: We prioritize the use of ethically sourced, organic, and sustainable ingredients in our products, ensuring they are free from harsh chemicals and toxins.
Water Conservation: We implement measures to reduce water usage and promote recycling within our operations.
Energy Efficiency: We invest in energy-efficient technologies and waste reduction measures to minimize our environmental footprint.
Waste Reduction: We minimize waste generation and promote recycling throughout our operations and supply chain.
Sustainable Packaging: We choose eco-friendly packaging options, such as recycled materials and biodegradable containers, to reduce waste.
Product Development: We develop products with minimal environmental impact during their use phase, including creating biodegradable and compostable products.
Customer Health and Safety: We ensure customer health and safety by adhering to stringent quality control and safety standards.
Sustainable Consumption: We promote sustainable consumption by advocating for environmentally friendly alternatives to synthetic materials.
Product End-of-Life: We promote responsible end-of-life management of products and packaging by supporting reuse, recycling, compost ability, refillable systems, and environmentally responsible disposal practices to reduce landfill waste and encourage circular economy principles.
Water usage reduction and recycling: We implement measures to reduce water consumption in production processes.
Waste minimization and recycling: We minimize waste generation through reduction, reuse, and recycling initiatives.
Contamination management: We ensure that all water used in production meets stringent microbiological standards, adhering to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) to prevent contamination.
Air pollution reduction: We intend to implement sustainable logistics strategies, including optimizing delivery routes and utilizing low-emission vehicles.
Noise pollution minimization: We aim to perform thorough evaluations of noise levels across all manufacturing facilities to identify primary noise sources and establish baseline data for monitoring the effectiveness of noise reduction initiatives.
We intend to equip high-noise machinery with acoustic enclosures and install sound barriers where necessary to contain noise.
Responsible raw material and chemical ma: We aim to develop and implement sustainable chemical and waste management strategies by 2030, focusing on priority chemicals of concern and adopting standards like the chemical footprint approach to reduce their impact along the value chain.
Biodegradable and compostable products: We ensure to eliminate single-use plastics in product packaging by 2030, in line with consumer demand for eco-friendly alternatives.
Promoting sustainable consumption: We aim to launch an educational campaign by 2030 to inform consumers about sustainable beauty routines, including the benefits of using eco-friendly products and reducing waste.
We plan to provide guidelines on product usage to minimize overconsumption and waste, promoting practices such as using appropriate amounts and proper storage to extend product life by 2030.
We intend to establish a platform for consumers to share their sustainable beauty practices and experiences, creating a community that supports and inspires responsible consumption by 2030.
Environmental Services and Advocacy: We aim to join industry-wide initiatives aimed at developing standardized environmental impact assessment and scoring systems for cosmetic products, promoting transparency and sustainability across the sector by 2030.
We plan to allocate funding to environmental research projects by 2030, focusing on innovative solutions to reduce the ecological footprint of cosmetic products and packaging.

By 2030, participate in public campaigns to raise awareness about environmental issues related to the cosmetics industry, encouraging consumers and other stakeholders to adopt more sustainable behaviours.

responsibilities.duty: Oversees the overall environmental strategy and approves long-term sustainability goals. Ensures alignment of environmental initiatives with business objectives and stakeholder expectations.
Leads the development and implementation of the Environmental policy across the organization. Reports directly to the CEO and provides regular updates to the Board of Directors.
Provides leadership in implementing the Environmental policy within their respective divisions. Allocates necessary resources and integrates sustainability metrics into performance evaluations.

A dedicated sustainability committee comprising representatives from various departments is established to oversee the execution of sustainability initiatives. The committee is tasked with developing action plans, monitoring performance, and recommending improvements to meet sustainability objectives.

Departmental heads are responsible for integrating sustainability practices into their respective areas of operation. They ensure compliance with environmental regulations, promote resource efficiency, and support employee engagement in sustainability efforts.
Ensures adherence to all applicable environmental laws, regulations, and standards. Conducts regular audits and maintains documentation for regulatory compliance.

All employees are encouraged to actively participate in sustainability initiatives. They are expected to adhere to sustainable practices, report any environmental concerns, and contribute ideas for continuous improvement.

policy.monitoring:
Annual Sustainability Dashboard:

The CSO presents a comprehensive sustainability dashboard to senior management and the Board. The dashboard highlights progress towards annual targets, emerging trends, and areas needing attention.

Environmental Incident Reporting:

A dedicated system for employees to report environmental incidents or near-misses. The Environmental Compliance Manager investigates all reports and implements corrective actions.

External reporting is conducted annually to communicate our sustainability performance to stakeholders, including customers, investors, and regulatory bodies.

Reports are prepared in accordance with internationally recognized standards such as the Global Reporting Initiative (GRI) guidelines, Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) or Sustainability Accounting Standards Board (SASB) framework.

We actively engage with stakeholders to gather feedback, address concerns, and foster transparency in our sustainability practices.

Stakeholder input is considered in decision-making processes and incorporated into sustainability initiatives where applicable.
policy.reviewMechanism:
An annual performance review is conducted to assess progress towards sustainability goals and targets.

Key achievements, challenges, and areas for improvement are identified through a comprehensive evaluation process.

Feedback from performance reviews, internal audits, and stakeholder engagement activities is used to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Adjustments to strategies, policies, and action plans are made as necessary to enhance sustainability performance and address emerging issues.

The Chief Sustainability Officer reviews this policy annually to ensure alignment with changing regulatory requirements, industry best practices, and stakeholder expectations.

Company can also change or review policy if any necessary changes is required.

Updates to the policy are communicated internally, and relevant training is provided to ensure awareness and compliance.
